svg.title: Febin K Renu, Calibre FKR-26
svg.desc: A mechanical watch movement beside the name Febin K Renu. The gear train turns at true ratios, the balance wheel swings and the escape wheel ticks with each beat. Beside it: calibrated models, honest negatives, and show their work. Software Developer at Entarch Solutions; Software Engineering Intern and Dev Lead at Grids Apps LLC; B.Tech CSE at Karunya Institute, CGPA 9.39; published SMAHI-ER at IEEE IEHNS 2026; based in Hyderabad, India.
